title: Scattering below the ground state for the three-dimensional focusing energy-critical NLS
summary: We prove global well-posedness and scattering for the three-dimensional focusing energy-critical nonlinear Schrödinger equation with initial data below the ground-state energy and gradient thresholds. This extends the seminal result of Kenig and Merle (Invent. Math., 2006) to general data in $\dot H^1(\mathbb R^3)$. Classical concentration compactness and the exclusion of rapid frequency cascades reduce the problem to the quasi-soliton scenario.
